Definition: adverb from G4707; more speedily, i.e. sooner than otherwise:--more carefully.
BiblicalUsage: The word is the adverb, more carefully: Paul sends Epaphroditus back the more carefully, that when the Philippians see him again they may rejoice, and Paul himself may be the less sorrowful.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the careful sending shows a pastor's heart: Paul hurries the reunion because he knows their joy and his own sorrow.
